meta.name: Synthetic Self-Regulation Knowledge Base
meta.note: Fully invented data for a technical assessment. Not clinical content and not for real use. Structure mirrors a routing knowledge base: emotional states link to frameworks, frameworks link to practices, and patterns are referenced by id.

frameworks.name: Breath Anchor
frameworks.summary: Bring attention to the breath to interrupt momentum and create a pause before responding.

frameworks.name: Two Column Reframe
frameworks.summary: Separate the automatic thought from a more balanced alternative, side by side.

frameworks.name: Name and Locate
frameworks.summary: Name the felt experience and locate where it sits in the body, without trying to change it.

frameworks.name: Urge Surfing
frameworks.summary: Observe a rising urge as a wave that peaks and passes rather than acting on it.

frameworks.name: Values Compass
frameworks.summary: Reconnect a small next action to a chosen value rather than to a mood.

frameworks.name: Cognitive Defusion
frameworks.summary: Create distance from a thought by observing it as a passing mental event rather than a fact.

practices.name: Thought sort
steps: Write a fairer version beside it

practices.name: Body scan check
steps: Notice head, chest, stomach in turn

practices.name: Letting the wave land
steps: Stay with it for one minute without fixing

practices.name: Urge timer
steps: Watch the urge rise and settle before deciding

practices.name: One small step
steps: Name one value that matters today
Choose the smallest action linked to it

practices.name: Values check in
steps: Ask what matters most right now
Ask what a next step toward it looks like

practices.name: Gentle permission
steps: Name one kind thing you would tell a friend

practices.name: Leaves on a stream
steps: Picture thoughts as leaves on water
Place each thought on a leaf

inquiry_patterns.text: What are you moving toward right now, and does it feel like your pace or someone else's?
If you had to name the single loudest thing in your head right now, what would it be?
When did you last feel even slightly lighter than you do now?
What would you want to say if you knew it would land gently?
Of everything on your mind, what actually needs you today, and what only feels urgent?
What is present right now that you would like to stay with a little longer?
What are you carrying that you have not let yourself set down yet?
When the loop starts, where does it usually try to take you?

mirror_patterns.text: It sounds like part of you is already leaning forward, waiting for something to begin.
There is a lot arriving at once, and it makes sense that it is hard to hold all of it.
Something in you has gone quiet, and that quiet is asking for gentleness rather than pushing.
The sharpness makes sense, it usually means something mattered to you.
It sounds safer, for now, to keep a little distance from all of it.
There is a steadiness here, and it is worth noticing that you found it.
The mind is working very hard to protect you, even when it does not feel like it.
This is heavy, and you do not have to carry it as though it were light.
